title: CASE No. 0002 - They Fixed It In October. It Came Back Bigger.
angle: Ford recalled 43,438 of these SUVs in October for a sound they would not make, updated the software and mailed the letters; in June the same recall came back covering 66,383, and the cars they already fixed have to be fixed again.

visual_system.hero_structure: exterior night street in one-point recession, the pair small on the road, the Institution a cold monolith at the vanishing point, resolving to two stacked federal records
visual_system.atmosphere: night exterior, rationed practical light: warm shop windows behind, cold ambient on the road
visual_system.palette_family: night steel / sodium amber, with brand PAPER and one STAMP
visual_system.continuity_device: camera: one unbroken slow push down the street, running the whole episode

divergence_check.vs_case_0001: case 0001 was hero 'interior two-hander against filing-cabinet wall', atmosphere 'fluorescent records room, dust column', palette 'manila/carbon', continuity 'motif:the drifting sheet', camera 'locked'. This episode differs on ALL FIVE required axes and also changes the set.
divergence_check.hero_structure: DIFFERS (exterior street recession vs interior cabinet wall)
divergence_check.atmosphere: DIFFERS (night exterior, rationed practical light vs fluorescent interior)

visual_system.why_this_set: The story is about a sound a car does not make. A quiet street at night is the subject drawn. The one-point recession also motivates the push: the camera walks down the road for the whole episode and never cuts away from it, which is the continuity device.

new_assets_note: NONE. Every element is cast from ASSET_MANIFEST.md. The library mandate says reuse with fresh staging is the point of the shelf, and freshness here comes from set, camera and palette, not from redrawing anything.

shots.action: Night street, camera already pushing. Ray alone, mid-road, arms-crossed, angry: he has already found out. The fact stated flat over him. At 2.0s the WORDMARK STAMPS, once, hard, never a fade. Dee is not in frame yet.
captions: Ford is recalling sixty-six thousand SUVs for a sound they don't make.
Federal law. Hybrids have to make a noise so people hear them coming.

shots.action: Two-shot. Dee has walked in holding the printout, upright and vertical against Ray's round bulk. Ray turns to her. She reads the October record off the page: they already did this.
captions: They did. October. Software update, letters mailed November fifth.

shots.beat: THE RATIO. the two numbers, placed, no commentary
shots.action: The first count rises as a card: 43,438, unmarked, plain. Then the second card lands beside it at the same size and the same weight: 66,383. The HIGHLIGHTER swipes ONCE, on 66,383 only. Nothing animates between them, there is no arrow and no arithmetic on screen. Dee delivers both flat.
captions: Forty-three thousand, four hundred thirty-eight vehicles.
It's back. Sixty-six thousand, three hundred eighty-three.
shots.discipline: The taxonomy says place the two numbers and shut up. Both cards are identical in size, colour and weight so the viewer does the arithmetic and the show never does. The highlighter is the episode's ONLY swipe.

shots.action: Back to the two-shot, tighter as the push closes. Ray goes to shock on 'They already fixed those', then arrives at the verdict. Dee supplies the agency's own word for it. The cards are gone; this beat is performance, not graphics.
captions: The ones they fixed have to be fixed again.
So the repair needs a repair.

shots.beat: the sorting key, and Dee's ONE crack
shots.action: A spec badge drops in reading 28 SPEAKERS, staged as a trim plate, the way a window sticker lists a feature. DEE_CRACK fires here: her composure survived both counts and breaks only when she has to read this line out loud. Ray goes smug and delivers the verdict on the SORTING.
captions: The fix they have is for Nautilus Hybrids with twenty-eight speakers.
Twenty-eight speakers. That's how they decide who gets fixed.
shots.HARD_GUARD_c11: The badge is a TRIM SPEC, never a diagram of the alert system. Nothing on screen may show the speakers failing, emitting, or trying to emit. No sound waves, no rings, no crossed-out speaker, no silence symbol. The claim is that the record SORTS cars by speaker count, not that the speakers are what broke.

shots.action: The monolith stands at the vanishing point, cold, rectilinear, too large for frame, and the street light does not reach it. Policy text rises on a cold plate over an automated read. Two emissions, verbatim. It does not budge and it does not acknowledge the question.
assets: institution plate (composition-local, HTML over the art)
shots.camera: push continues, straight down the road at the monolith
captions: The remedy is currently under development for all other Nautilus and Explorer Hybrid vehicles affected by this recall.
Interim letters notifying owners of the safety risk are expected to be mailed August third.
shots.HARD_GUARD_face: MachineShadow has NO FACE and never gets one. No eyes, no mouth, no tilt, no reaction, no emotive motion of any kind. It is a process working exactly as designed.

shots.beat: the button: the receipt, then the end card
shots.action: Cut to PAPER. The two federal records stacked, campaign numbers, months and counts legible, with the Remedy sentence beneath: 'Any vehicles previously repaired under 25V691 must have the new remedy completed.' The STAMP lands ONCE on the June record. Dee: that's tomorrow. Ray does not win: 'I still have the first letter.' Then the end card, case number and the promise, nothing else.
shots.camera: the push stops. The document is the only locked frame in the episode, which is what makes it read as evidence.
captions: I still have the first letter.
shots.button_document: NHTSA campaigns 25V691000 (OCT 2025, 43,438) and 26V415000 (JUN 2026, 66,383), stacked, plus the previously-repaired Remedy sentence. Document type 34-46px on PAPER.

tonal_line: No impact, no injury, no near miss, no pedestrian in frame, no car in motion anywhere in the episode. The human cost of a car nobody hears is not funny and is not staged. The joke lives entirely on the paperwork, the two counts and the voided repair.
